orig.il: And it came to pass on the morrow
to thyself, and to all thy friends

orig.gloss: and/ he will take into exile/ them
orig.il: and he shall carry them captive

orig.gloss: and/ he will strike down/ them

orig.il: thereof, and all the precious things
there, thou, and all thy friends

orig.gloss: and/ let us tell about/ him

orig.il: against him, and we shall take
on them: for unto thee have I opened

orig.gloss: and/ they have come to an end
